Hi Samir / Alyssa —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and the agreed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Use case: customer support automation + internal summarization for fraud ops (pilot).
- Target launch for pilot: late March (2–3 week pilot).
- Primary success metrics: latency under 300ms p50 for doc lookups, monthly token cost target <$0.02/1000 tokens.

Action items:
1) Redwood (Marissa) will hand off to your procurement team for vendor setup, W-9, and ACH details.
2) FinServe to confirm billing entity and submit W-9/ACH info into the vendor portal (we'll send the portal invite).
3) Redwood to provide SOC 2 and the W-9 (attached), plus a short vendor checklist.

I attached: FinServe_MA-Checklist.pdf (checklist of procurement items) and Redwood_W-9.pdf.

Marissa — copying you to start the vendor setup and send the portal invite to procurement@finserve.com.

Samir / Alyssa — any preference on the billing email or entity name? If not, I'll route to Marissa and the portal invite will come from our vendor portal.

Thanks,
